verdict.rationale: Alloy documents configurable workflows, Journeys, and scheduled Portfolio workflows, so versioning and rollback of those automations is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack never mentions workflow version history, change review or approval, or rollback. The homepage claim of "fully auditable agentic automation" describes auditability of decisions, which is an adjacent capability and not versioning or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
